behavior_constraints: run accepts repeated --skip-stage <name> and errors with unknown stage: <name> for nonexistent skip targets
skipped stages have status skipped, no outputs, duration_ms 0, and direct/transitive dependents are auto-skipped
skipped stages are not cached and are excluded from cache_stats; pipeline status remains success when only skipped stages are non-success
ensemble stage type accepts inputs.models array with at least 2 models, inputs.data, params.strategy vote|average, and params.target
ensemble outputs predictions dataset and a virtual model with algorithm ensemble containing references to constituent models
ensemble vote selects majority predicted class per row with ties broken by lowest numeric class; average returns arithmetic mean of model predictions
ensemble stages are cacheable like other stages and appear in plan output with output ports predictions and model
mlpipe validate <config.json> outputs valid and errors, reports all validation errors, accepts --param key=value, does not plan/check cache/execute/mutate
pipeline on_failure stop halts on first failure; continue runs independent stages, marks dependents of failed stages as skipped, and sets overall status failed if any stage failed

entities.summary: This round adds run-time stage skipping with cascading skips, an ensemble stage type, a standalone validate command, and continue-on-failure pipeline execution.

instruction_head:
We're expanding the pipeline tool to handle more realistic production scenarios — specifically around flow control, ensemble models, and validation.

## 1. Stage Skipping

Users sometimes need to re-run a pipeline while bypassing certain stages. The `run` command now accepts `--skip-stage <name>` flags (can be specified multiple times) to skip named stages during execution.
